data.cultural_impact: The name Qadria holds a deep cultural significance within the Islamic community. The name is of Arabic origin and is derived from the word "Qadir," which means all-powerful or capable in Arabic. The suffix "ia" in the name denotes a female given name. Amongst Muslims, this name is often given to girls as a reminder of their innate capabilities and strength in Allah. It also reflects the immense power and sovereignty of Allah in one's life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Qadria also has significant spiritual implications. With its root in "Qadir," which means powerful and capable, the name signifies the spiritual power and strength that comes from faith and devotion to Allah. It also conveys the belief that Qadria, as a believer, is vested with immense spiritual capabilities that can help her overcome challenges and lead a fulfilling life.
